<!-- pr-reviewer: 36f8ff2c3de92369053aedc1d7b04e6c23e45499 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The guide covers the changes listed in issue #1939. All 48 merged PRs through main cda3d58965843c30c6c70d59c06ac27c4dcda8b0 have an entry in the issue audit. The new text states the machine limits and gives actions for refused operations.

Local results:
- The trial merge with upstream/main was clean. The PR already contains that main commit.
- All 16 site tests passed. These include the eight new guide tests, internal links, anchors, old page addresses and operation pictures.
- Zola 0.23.6 built 42 pages and 10 sections. The first test run could not find Zola on PATH. The repeat run used the local Zola executable and passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: zero steps and zero failures. No Rust crate changed, so Rust build, crate tests and Clippy do not apply.
- In separate temporary copies, replacement of the 2D page with the main version caused seven failed assertions. Replacement of the EDM page caused two failures. After each page was restored, all eight new tests passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main` passed.

This PR changes documentation and documentation tests only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks or stock simulation. No NC, CL or image golden changed. No crates/ui file changed, so before and after UI images are not required.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
